agent_notes: NIRF listings establish the assigned institution in Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh; same-name Vallabh Vidyanagar, Gujarat rows were excluded.
The official site identifies a unitary campus at Sardar Patel Knowledge City, Waraseoni Road, Dongariya, Balaghat.
The managed proxy returned the exact self-signed certificate-chain error; permitted --insecure fallback was used only for public GETs on expected domains.

Detailed course tables are available for engineering, agriculture, pharmacy, nursing, paramedical education, education, commerce and management, science/computer applications, law, and arts/social science. The Ayurveda page has no structured course table, while the enquiry form lists additional options such as BAMS, MD Ayurveda, Post Basic B.Sc Nursing, M.Sc Nursing, and ANM Nursing without detailed programme pages. The Ph.D. notification confirms doctoral admissions but lacks discipline-specific catalogue details. Manual review is required.
